parts.title: 大問1 短文の語句空所補充
parts.desc: 短い文や会話の空所に入る単語・熟語・文法を4つから選ぶ
parts.tip: まず空所の前と後ろの語を見る（take ＿ of → care、than → 比較級）。次に文の後半やもう1つの文を読んで、意味のヒントを探す。迷ったら、選択肢を1つずつ入れて日本語にしてみる。
parts.intro: Choose the best word or phrase to fill the blank.

questions.q:
A: You look ____, Ken. Did you sleep well last night?
B: No. I watched a movie until two o'clock.
questions.why: tired＝「疲れた」。2時まで映画を見て寝ていない、という返事と合う。famous（有名な）、careful（注意深い）、strong（強い）は寝不足と関係がない。
questions.ja:
A：ケン、（　）ように見えるね。昨夜はよく眠れた？
B：ううん。2時まで映画を見ていたんだ。

questions.q: Lisa's family is going to ____ to a new house next month. It is near her grandparents' home.
questions.why: move to ～＝「～に引っ越す」。新しい家、と続くのでこれ。break（こわす）、grow（育つ）、forget（忘れる）は to a new house とつながらない。
questions.ja: リサの家族は来月、新しい家に（　）予定です。それは祖父母の家の近くです。

questions.q: There were no empty ____ on the bus this morning, so Takuya had to stand all the way to school.
questions.why: seat＝「座席」。立っていなければならなかった、という後半から、座る所が無かったと分かる。tickets（切符）、roads（道）、windows（窓）では立つ理由にならない。
questions.ja: 今朝はバスに空いている（　）が無かったので、タクヤは学校までずっと立っていなければなりませんでした。

questions.q:
A: How was your trip to Kyoto, Emma?
B: It was great. I took a lot of ____ of old temples.
questions.why: take pictures＝「写真を撮る」。take とセットで使えるのは pictures だけ。letters（手紙）、songs（歌）、stories（物語）は「撮る」ことができない。
questions.ja:
A：エマ、京都への旅行はどうだった？
B：最高だったよ。古いお寺の（　）をたくさん撮ったの。

questions.q: Jim's sister can speak three ____. They are English, French, and Chinese.
questions.why: language＝「言語」。英語・フランス語・中国語はどれも言葉。countries（国）、subjects（教科）、sports（スポーツ）は speak（話す）の目的語にならない。
questions.ja: ジムのお姉さんは3つの（　）を話せます。英語とフランス語と中国語です。

questions.q: It's very cold outside today. Don't forget to ____ your coat and gloves when you go out.
questions.why: wear＝「身に着ける」。寒いので、出かける時にコートを着る。make（作る）、wash（洗う）、sell（売る）は出かける時にすることではない。
questions.ja: 今日は外がとても寒いです。出かける時にコートと手ぶくろを（　）のを忘れないでね。

questions.q: The city library is ____ on Mondays, so you can't borrow any books on that day.
questions.why: closed＝「閉まっている」。本を借りられない理由になるのはこれだけ。bright（明るい）、heavy（重い）、famous（有名な）では借りられない理由にならない。
questions.ja: 市の図書館は月曜日は（　）ので、その日は本を借りられません。

questions.q:
A: Excuse me. Do you know the ____ to the station?
B: Yes. Go straight and turn left at the bank.
questions.why: the way to ～＝「～への道」。B が道順を教えているので way。name（名前）、time（時間）、story（話）では道順の答えと合わない。
questions.ja:
A：すみません。駅への（　）を知っていますか。
B：はい。まっすぐ行って、銀行の所を左に曲がってください。

questions.q: Kumi practiced the piano every day for a year, so she ____ first prize in the music contest.
questions.why: win first prize＝「1位を取る」。won は win の過去形。毎日練習した結果なので「取った」。lost（失った）は逆で、caught（つかまえた）、built（建てた）は prize と合わない。
questions.ja: クミは1年間毎日ピアノを練習したので、音楽コンテストで1位を（　）。

questions.q: My father usually reads the ____ at breakfast. He likes to know what is happening in the world.
questions.why: newspaper＝「新聞」。世界の出来事を知るために読む物。calendar（カレンダー）、dictionary（辞書）、menu（メニュー）ではニュースは分からない。
questions.ja: 父はたいてい朝食の時に（　）を読みます。世界で何が起きているかを知るのが好きなのです。

questions.q: Paul was ____ because he left his homework at home. But his teacher said he could bring it tomorrow.
questions.why: worried＝「心配して」。宿題を忘れた時の気持ち。But（でも）の後で先生が許してくれるので、前は困った気持ち。excited（わくわくした）、proud（ほこらしい）、lucky（運がいい）は合わない。
questions.ja: ポールは宿題を家に忘れたので（　）。でも先生は、明日持ってきてもいいと言いました。

questions.q:
A: This bag is too ____ for me. Do you have a cheaper one?
B: Yes. How about this one? It's 15 dollars.
questions.why: expensive＝「値段が高い」。「もっと安いのは？」と聞いているので、値段の話。short（短い）、young（若い）、sick（病気の）は値段と関係がない。
questions.ja:
A：このかばんは私には（　）すぎます。もっと安いのはありますか。
B：はい。こちらはいかがですか。15ドルです。

questions.q: Sam's grandmother lives in a small ____ in the mountains. Only about 200 people live there.
questions.why: village＝「村」。山の中で200人ほどが住む所。ocean（海）、airport（空港）、planet（惑星）は山の中の住む場所ではない。
questions.ja: サムのおばあさんは山の中の小さな（　）に住んでいます。そこには200人ほどしか住んでいません。

questions.q: Please be ____ in the library. Other people are reading and studying there.
questions.why: quiet＝「静かな」。ほかの人が勉強している、という理由と合う。loud（うるさい）は逆。angry（怒った）、hungry（おなかがすいた）は図書館のルールと関係がない。
questions.ja: 図書館では（　）してください。ほかの人がそこで読書や勉強をしています。

questions.q: Yuki ____ an old friend at the shopping mall yesterday. They had not seen each other for five years.
questions.why: met は meet（会う）の過去形。5年ぶりに会った、という2文目と合う。sent（送った）、taught（教えた）、lent（貸した）は友だちを目的語にすると意味が通らない。
questions.ja: ユキは昨日、ショッピングモールで昔の友だちに（　）。2人は5年間会っていなかったのです。

questions.q:
A: What's your favorite ____, Tom?
B: Math. I like solving problems with numbers.
questions.why: subject＝「教科」。答えが Math（数学）なので教科を聞いている。season（季節）、color（色）、animal（動物）の答えにはならない。
questions.ja:
A：トム、一番好きな（　）は何？
B：数学だよ。数字を使って問題を解くのが好きなんだ。

questions.q: The weather ____ says it will rain tomorrow afternoon, so let's take our umbrellas.
questions.why: weather report＝「天気予報」。「明日は雨と言っている」物。sign（看板）、club（クラブ）、race（競走）は天気を教えてくれない。
questions.ja: 天気（　）によると明日の午後は雨なので、かさを持っていきましょう。

questions.q: Mike ____ his bike to school every day. It takes him about fifteen minutes.
questions.why: ride a bike＝「自転車に乗る」。bike とセットになる動詞は ride。draws（描く）、flies（飛ぶ）、swims（泳ぐ）は自転車で学校に行く意味にならない。
questions.ja: マイクは毎日学校まで自転車に（　）。15分くらいかかります。

questions.q: Ms. Ito's students made a big cake to ____ her birthday. She was very happy.
questions.why: celebrate＝「祝う」。誕生日のためにケーキを作ったので「祝う」。invite（招待する）は人を目的語にする。borrow（借りる）、repeat（くり返す）は誕生日と合わない。
questions.ja: イトウ先生の生徒たちは、先生の誕生日を（　）ために大きなケーキを作りました。先生はとても喜びました。

questions.q:
A: Did you finish the book I lent you?
B: Not yet. It's very long, but it's really ____.
questions.why: interesting＝「おもしろい」。long, but ～（長いけど～）なので、後ろは良いこと。tired（疲れた）、sorry（すまない）は人の気持ちで、empty（空の）は本の中身に合わない。
questions.ja:
A：私が貸した本は読み終わった？
B：まだだよ。とても長いけど、本当に（　）よ。

questions.q: Ben fell down and hurt his leg during soccer practice, so he had to go to the ____.
questions.why: hospital＝「病院」。けがをしたので病院へ。bakery（パン屋）、stadium（競技場）、bookstore（本屋）はけがを治す所ではない。
questions.ja: ベンはサッカーの練習中に転んで足をけがしたので、（　）に行かなければなりませんでした。

questions.q: Karen got up late this morning, so she had to eat her breakfast very ____.
questions.why: quickly＝「急いで・速く」。寝ぼうしたので急いで食べた。slowly（ゆっくり）は逆。loudly（大声で）、kindly（親切に）は食べ方として合わない。
questions.ja: カレンは今朝寝ぼうしたので、とても（　）朝ごはんを食べなければなりませんでした。

questions.q: The concert hall was already ____, so we could not get tickets for the show.
questions.why: full＝「いっぱいの・満員の」。チケットが買えなかった理由になる。empty（空の）は逆。dark（暗い）、cheap（安い）では買えない理由にならない。
questions.ja: コンサートホールはもう（　）だったので、私たちはショーのチケットを買えませんでした。

questions.q: Jenny loves animals very much, so she wants to work at a ____ in the future.
questions.why: zoo＝「動物園」。動物が好き、という理由と合う職場。bank（銀行）、factory（工場）、library（図書館）は動物と関係がない。
questions.ja: ジェニーは動物が大好きなので、将来は（　）で働きたいと思っています。

questions.q: Ryan ____ only one mistake on his math test, so he got 95 points.
questions.why: make a mistake＝「まちがえる」。mistake とセットの動詞は make（過去形 made）。took・gave・kept は mistake と組み合わせない。
questions.ja: ライアンは数学のテストでまちがいを1つしか（　）なかったので、95点を取りました。

questions.q:
A: What's the ____ between these two watches?
B: This one is lighter, but the price is the same.
questions.why: difference between A and B＝「AとBの違い」。B が「こっちの方が軽い」と違いを答えている。reason（理由）、chance（機会）、problem（問題）では between ～ と合わない。
questions.ja:
A：この2つの腕時計の（　）は何ですか。
B：こちらの方が軽いですが、値段は同じです。

questions.q:
A: I'm looking ____ to seeing you at the party next week.
B: Me, too. See you on Saturday!
questions.why: look forward to ～ing＝「～を楽しみにする」。後ろに to seeing があるので forward。look around（見回す）、look after（世話をする）、look up（調べる）は to とつながらない。
questions.ja:
A：来週パーティーで会えるのを（　）しているよ。
B：私もだよ。土曜日に会おうね！

questions.q: Takeshi is good ____ playing the guitar. He sometimes plays at school events.
questions.why: be good at ～＝「～が得意だ」。前置詞は at と覚える。in・for・of は good の後ろで「得意」の意味にならない。
questions.ja: タケシはギターをひくのが（　）です。彼はときどき学校の行事でひいています。

questions.q: My sister takes care ____ our dog when I go on a school trip.
questions.why: take care of ～＝「～の世話をする」。前置詞は of。for・to・with ではこの熟語にならない。
questions.ja: 私が修学旅行に行く時は、姉が私たちの犬の（　）をします。

questions.q:
A: I'm going to Hawaii with my family this summer.
B: That's wonderful! Have a good ____.
questions.why: Have a good time.＝「楽しんでね」。出かける人へのあいさつ。habit（習慣）、color（色）、number（数）では意味が通らない。
questions.ja:
A：この夏、家族とハワイに行くんだ。
B：すてきだね！（　）を過ごしてね。

questions.q: Last summer, Maria went to Canada for the first ____. She had never been abroad before.
questions.why: for the first time＝「初めて」。それまで外国に行ったことがない、と2文目で説明している。place・way・year は for the first ～ で「初めて」の意味にならない。
questions.ja: 去年の夏、マリアは（　）カナダに行きました。それまで外国に行ったことがありませんでした。

questions.q:
A: Can I try ____ this jacket?
B: Of course. The fitting room is over there.
questions.why: try on ～＝「～を試着する」。試着室（fitting room）が答えのヒント。up・over・at は try と組んで「着てみる」にならない。
questions.ja:
A：このジャケットを（　）してもいいですか。
B：もちろんです。試着室はあちらです。

questions.q: My brother and I ____ turns washing the dishes after dinner.
questions.why: take turns ～ing＝「交代で～する」。turns と組む動詞は take。keep・bring・put は turns と組まない。
questions.ja: 兄と私は夕食の後、（　）お皿を洗います。

questions.q: Mr. Davis is very kind. He always helps people who are ____ trouble.
questions.why: be in trouble＝「困っている」。前置詞は in。on・at・by は trouble と組んで「困っている」の意味にならない。
questions.ja: デイビスさんはとても親切です。（　）人をいつも助けています。

questions.q: This box is ____ than that one, so please carry it with both hands.
questions.why: than（～より）があるので比較級。heavy の比較級は heavier（y を i にして er）。more heavy とは言わない。heaviest は「一番」の時に使う。
questions.ja: この箱はあの箱より（　）ので、両手で運んでください。

questions.q:
A: Have you ever ____ to Okinawa?
B: Yes. I went there with my family two years ago.
questions.why: Have you ever been to ～?＝「～に行ったことがありますか」。have の後ろは過去分詞なので been。go・went・going は have の後ろに置けない。
questions.ja:
A：沖縄に（　）ことはある？
B：うん。2年前に家族と行ったよ。

questions.q: The girl ____ is talking with Mr. Smith over there is my cousin.
questions.why: The girl を後ろから説明する関係代名詞。人なので who。which は物、where は場所に使い、what は名詞の後ろに置かない。
questions.ja: あそこでスミスさんと話している女の子は私のいとこです。

questions.q: My mother told me ____ my room before dinner, so I did it right after school.
questions.why: tell 人 to ～＝「人に～するように言う」。told me の後ろは to＋動詞の原形。clean・cleaning・cleaned はこの形に入らない。
questions.ja: 母は夕食の前に部屋を（　）ように私に言ったので、放課後すぐにやりました。

questions.q: This old castle in our town was ____ about 400 years ago. Many tourists visit it every year.
questions.why: was＋過去分詞で「～された」（受け身）。build の過去分詞は built。お城は自分で建てないので「建てられた」になる。
questions.ja: 町にあるこの古いお城は約400年前に（　）。毎年たくさんの観光客が訪れます。

questions.q:
A: What are you doing, Ken?
B: I'm looking for my key. I don't know ____ I put it.
questions.why: I don't know where ～＝「どこに～か分からない」。かぎを探しているので「場所」を表す where。who（だれ）、which（どれ）、what（何）は I put it の文とつながらない。
questions.ja:
A：ケン、何をしているの？
B：かぎを探しているんだ。どこに置いたか分からないんだよ。

parts.title: 大問2 会話文の空所補充
parts.desc: 2人の短い会話の空所に入る文や語句を4つから選ぶ
parts.tip: 空所の「後ろ」の文が一番のヒント。相手の返事（時間・場所・Yes/No）から、どんな質問や返事が入るかを考える。How long・How often・What time など、質問の形にも注意。
parts.intro: Read the conversation and choose the best answer for the blank.

sets.passage:
Boy: Mom, I can't find my soccer shoes. ( )
Mother: I saw them by the front door this morning.

questions.why: 母が「玄関のそばで見た」と答えているので、「見なかった？」と聞いたと分かる。洗ってほしい・小さすぎる・試合はいつ、には「見た場所」の答えは合わない。
questions.ja:
男の子：お母さん、サッカーシューズが見つからないんだ。（　）
母：今朝、玄関のそばで見たわよ。

sets.passage:
Girl: This cake is delicious. Did you make it?
Boy: ( ) My grandmother taught me how to make it.

questions.why: 後ろで「祖母が作り方を教えてくれた」と言っているので、自分で作った。Did you ～? には Yes, I did. で答える。「買った」は後ろの文と合わない。
questions.ja:
女の子：このケーキ、おいしい。あなたが作ったの？
男の子：（　）おばあちゃんが作り方を教えてくれたんだ。

sets.passage:
Man: Excuse me. Is there a post office near here?
Woman: ( ) Go down this street, and it's on your right.

questions.why: Is there ～? には Yes, there is. で答え、その後に行き方を説明している。No, there isn't.（無い）や「見たことがない」と言ってから道を教えるのはおかしい。
questions.ja:
男性：すみません。この近くに郵便局はありますか。
女性：（　）この通りを行くと、右側にありますよ。

sets.passage:
Teacher: You look sad, Amy. ( )
Student: I lost my favorite pen. My aunt gave it to me.

questions.why: What's wrong?＝「どうしたの？」。悲しそうな人にかける言葉で、生徒は理由を答えている。「どこに行ったの？」「週末はどうだった？」は理由の答えと合わない。
questions.ja:
先生：エイミー、悲しそうだね。（　）
生徒：お気に入りのペンをなくしたんです。おばがくれた物なんです。

sets.passage:
Girl: Let's go to the movies this Saturday.
Boy: I'm sorry, ( ) I have to visit my uncle in the hospital.

questions.why: I'm sorry と言い、後ろで行けない理由（お見舞い）を言っているので「行けない」。ほかの3つは行く話になってしまう。
questions.ja:
女の子：今週の土曜日、映画に行こうよ。
男の子：ごめん、（　）入院しているおじさんのお見舞いに行かなきゃいけないんだ。

sets.passage:
Mother: Would you like some more salad, Tom? There's a lot left.
Son: ( ) I'm already full. It was really good, though.

questions.why: I'm already full（もうおなかいっぱい）なので、ていねいに断る No, thank you. が入る。Yes, please. は「お願い」で逆。Here you are. は物をわたす時の言葉。
questions.ja:
母：トム、サラダをもう少しどう？たくさん残っているのよ。
息子：（　）もうおなかがいっぱいなんだ。でも、とてもおいしかったよ。

sets.passage:
Woman: How long does it take to get to the airport by taxi?
Man: ( ) But it may take longer in the evening.

questions.why: How long does it take ～? は「どのくらい時間がかかるか」。答えは時間の長さ。値段（20ドル）、回数（週3回）、場所（次の角）は合わない。
questions.ja:
女性：空港までタクシーでどのくらい時間がかかりますか。
男性：（　）でも夕方はもっとかかるかもしれません。

sets.passage:
Boy: Whose umbrella is this? It was by the door.
Girl: ( ) She left it here after the meeting.

questions.why: Whose ～? は「だれの」。後ろで She（彼女）と言うので、女性の名前が入る。It's mine.（私の）だと She とつながらない。
questions.ja:
男の子：これはだれのかさ？ドアのそばにあったよ。
女の子：（　）彼女が会議の後に置いていったの。

sets.passage:
Girl: I'm going to the store. Do you need anything?
Brother: ( ) Could you get some milk for me?

questions.why: 後ろで牛乳をたのんでいるので、「うん、1つだけ」が合う。No, I'm fine.（大丈夫、いらない）だと牛乳をたのむのと逆になる。
questions.ja:
女の子：お店に行ってくるね。何かいる？
兄：（　）牛乳を買ってきてくれる？

sets.passage:
Man: Hello. This is Bob. Can I speak to Jessica, please?
Woman: ( ) Can I take a message?

questions.why: Can I take a message?（伝言を聞きましょうか）は、本人が電話に出られない時の言葉。だから「今いない」が入る。Just a minute.（少し待って）なら本人に代わるので合わない。
questions.ja:
男性：もしもし、ボブです。ジェシカさんをお願いできますか。
女性：（　）伝言をうかがいましょうか。

sets.passage:
Boy: What time does the next train for Easton leave?
Station worker: ( ) You have ten minutes.

questions.why: What time ～? には時刻で答える。At 3:15.（3時15分に）。ホーム（Platform 2）、値段、時間の長さ（For two hours）は What time の答えではない。
questions.ja:
男の子：イーストン行きの次の電車は何時に出ますか。
駅員：（　）あと10分ありますよ。

sets.passage:
Girl: How often do you practice the piano?
Boy: ( ) I want to be a pianist someday.

questions.why: How often ～? は「どのくらいの回数・ひんど」。答えは Every day.（毎日）。期間（3年間）、だれと、どこで、は How often の答えではない。
questions.ja:
女の子：どのくらいピアノを練習するの？
男の子：（　）いつかピアニストになりたいんだ。

sets.passage:
Waiter: Good evening. Are you ready to order?
Woman: ( ) I'm still looking at the menu. Everything looks so good.

questions.why: まだメニューを見ている、と言うので「まだです」。パスタを注文する・おいしかった・お会計、はどれも後ろの文と合わない。
questions.ja:
ウェイター：こんばんは。ご注文はお決まりですか。
女性：（　）まだメニューを見ているところです。どれもおいしそうで。

sets.passage:
Student: Ms. Kato, I finished my report. Where should I put it?
Teacher: ( ) I'll read it tonight.

questions.why: Where ～? は場所をたずねている。On my desk（私の机の上に）が場所の答え。Next Monday（いつ）、In English（何語で）は Where の答えではない。
questions.ja:
生徒：カトウ先生、レポートが終わりました。どこに置けばいいですか。
先生：（　）今夜読みますね。

sets.passage:
Boy: I have a math test tomorrow, but I don't understand this question.
Sister: ( ) I'm good at math.

questions.why: 分からない弟に、数学が得意な姉が言う言葉なので「手伝ってあげる」。買い物にさそう・よくできたね、は困っている弟への返事として合わない。
questions.ja:
男の子：明日数学のテストがあるのに、この問題が分からないんだ。
姉：（　）私、数学が得意なのよ。

sets.passage:
Woman: Excuse me. This blue hat is really nice. ( )
Clerk: It's 25 dollars. It's on sale today.

questions.why: 店員が値段（25ドル）を答えているので、How much ～?（いくら）。色・作った人・試着は値段の答えとつながらない。
questions.ja:
女性：すみません。この青い帽子、とてもすてきですね。（　）
店員：25ドルです。今日はセール中ですよ。

sets.passage:
Girl: Did you enjoy your trip to London?
Boy: Yes, ( ) I want to go there again next year.

questions.why: Yes と言い、また行きたいと言うので「とても楽しかった」。行ったことがない・来週行く、は「旅行を楽しんだ？」の答えと合わない。
questions.ja:
女の子：ロンドン旅行は楽しかった？
男の子：うん、（　）来年またそこに行きたいな。

sets.passage:
Father: Amy, it's already ten o'clock. ( ) You have to get up early tomorrow.
Daughter: OK, Dad. Good night.

questions.why: 娘が Good night.（おやすみ）と答えているので、「寝る時間だよ」。朝ごはん・起きた？は夜の会話に合わない。
questions.ja:
父：エイミー、もう10時だよ。（　）明日は早起きしなきゃいけないよ。
娘：分かった、お父さん。おやすみなさい。

sets.passage:
Boy: Can I use your eraser for a minute? I left mine at home.
Girl: ( ) Here you are.

questions.why: Can I ～? は「～してもいい？」。後ろで Here you are.（はい、どうぞ）と消しゴムをわたしているので「いいよ」。No, I didn't. や Yes, it is. は質問の形に合わない。
questions.ja:
男の子：ちょっと消しゴムを使ってもいい？自分のを家に忘れちゃったんだ。
女の子：（　）はい、どうぞ。

sets.passage:
Girl: Excuse me. Which bus goes to City Hall?
Man: ( ) It leaves every 15 minutes.

questions.why: Which bus ～? は「どのバス」。答えは「5番に乗って」。後ろの It（それ）はバスのことなので、バスの名前が先に出ている必要がある。
questions.ja:
女の子：すみません。どのバスが市役所に行きますか。
男性：（　）15分おきに出ていますよ。

parts.title: 大問3A 掲示・案内
parts.desc: お知らせやポスター（約105語）を読み、内容に合う答えを2問選ぶ
parts.tip: 先に質問を読んで、「いつ・どこ・だれ・何をすればいいか」のどれを探すか決める。日時や場所は Date / Time / Place の行に、お願いや注意は最後の方に書かれていることが多い。

sets.passage:

pay one dollar to Ms. Carter.

sets.passage:

Dates: Every Saturday in July and August
Time: 7:00 p.m. to 8:30 p.m.
Price: Adults $12, children $6

questions.q: What can people do on the night tours?

Give food to the owls and bats.
Take pictures of the lions with a flash.
Stay at the zoo until the morning.
questions.why: 4段落目：夜に食べ物を探すフクロウやコウモリを見られる。動物にえさをあげるとは書いていない。フラッシュは使ってはいけない。

questions.q: What do people need to do before they join a tour?
choices: Buy a flashlight at the zoo.
Call the zoo staff on Saturday.
Make a reservation on the zoo's website.
Bring a child under 10 years old.
questions.why: 5段落目：各ツアーは20人だけなので、ウェブサイトで予約が必要。懐中電灯はスタッフが使う物で、買う必要はない。

sets.passage:
Free Guitar Lessons for Beginners

Place: Music Room, Maple Community Center

questions.why: 3段落目：12歳から18歳ならだれでも無料で参加できる。初心者向け（for Beginners）なので、上手な人やバンドの人だけではない。

questions.q: People who don't have a guitar should
choices: tell the center when they sign up.
come to the first lesson early.
questions.why: 4段落目：ギターが無い人は、センターで借りられるので、申し込む時に伝える。Mr. Hill から買うとは書いていない。

sets.passage:
Grand Opening of Snowy Ice Cream!

Opening day: Saturday, June 7
Hours: 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. (closed on Wednesdays)

questions.q: What is special about the honey and lemon flavor?
choices: Its honey comes from a local farm.
It is sold only on Wednesdays.
It is free for all customers.
questions.why: 3段落目：はちみつは町の近くの農場の物。from a farm near our town を a local farm と言いかえている。水曜日は定休日。

questions.q: How can people get 10 percent off in June?
choices: By bringing the poster to the shop.

parts.title: 大問3B Eメール（往復2通）
parts.desc: 2通のEメール（約295語）を読み、内容に合う答えを3問選ぶ
parts.tip: From と To で「だれからだれへ」をまずつかむ。1問目・2問目は1通目、3問目は2通目から出ることが多い。答えは本文の語を別の言い方に変えていることが多いので（had a cold → was sick）、意味で選ぶ。
parts.intro: Read the e-mails and choose the best answer to each question.

sets.passage:
From: Emily Brown
To: Ruth Brown
Date: October 20
Subject: My school play

Dear Grandma,

How are you? I have some exciting news. Last month, I joined the drama club at school. We practice three times a week after school. Our club is going to put on a play on November 15 at the school hall, and I got the role of an old queen! I have a lot of lines to remember, so I practice every night in my room. Our teacher, Mr. Wood, says that I'm doing a good job, but I'm still a little nervous.

Grandma, can you and Grandpa come to see the play? It starts at six in the evening. Also, I need a long dress for my role. You told me before that you have an old party dress. Could I borrow it for the play? I'll be very careful with it.

Love,
Emily

From: Ruth Brown
To: Emily Brown
Date: October 21
Subject: Of course!

Hi Emily,

Thank you for your e-mail. Congratulations on getting a big role! Grandpa and I would love to come and see your play. But you know we don't like driving at night, so I called your father. He said he will pick us up at our house at five o'clock.

About the dress, of course you can borrow it. It's dark red and very long, so I think it will be perfect for a queen. I'll bring it to your house this Sunday. Please try it on then. If it is too big for you, I can make it a little smaller.

Grandpa says he will bring his camera and take a lot of pictures of you on the stage. I'm so proud of you. Good luck with your practice!

Love,
Grandma

questions.q: What did Emily do last month?
choices: She went to see a play with her grandparents.
She bought a dress for a party.
She wrote a play for the school hall.
She joined a club at her school.
questions.why: 1通目の最初：先月、学校の演劇部に入った。the drama club を a club at her school と言いかえている。

questions.q: What does Emily ask her grandmother to do?
choices: Make a new dress for her.
Drive her to the school hall.
questions.why: 1通目の2段落目：Could I borrow it?（借りてもいい？）と古いドレスを借りたいと頼んでいる。小さくするのは、大きすぎた時だけ。

questions.q: How will Emily's grandparents get to the play?
choices: They will drive their own car.
They will take a bus at five.
Emily will meet them at the station.
questions.why: 2通目：祖父母は夜の運転が好きではないので、Emily の父が5時に家まで迎えに来る（pick us up）。

sets.passage:
From: Daniel Ross
To: Kevin Yamada
Date: February 2

From: Kevin Yamada
To: Daniel Ross

His sister wants to study history in Japan.

questions.q: What will Kevin do on March 29?
choices: Meet Daniel at the train station.
Go to a food market with his mother.

questions.q: What does Kevin's mother want to do?

Have dinner with Daniel's family at her house.

sets.passage:
From: Jason Miller
To: Olivia Carter

I'll also write down everything you need to know on a piece of paper.

From: Olivia Carter
To: Jason Miller
Date: July 10
Subject: Re: A favor

Hi Jason,

Sure, I'd be happy to help! I asked my mom, and she said it's OK. My little brother Sam is very excited, too. He has wanted a pet for a long time, but our apartment is too small for a dog or a cat. He says he will give Coco her apple every day.

questions.q: What does Jason say about Coco?

She needs food three times a day.
She likes to play with cats.

questions.q: When should Jason bring Coco to Olivia's house?

From: Lucy Adams
To: Ms. Parker

Give Lucy some advice about it.

parts.title: 大問3C 説明文
parts.desc: 人物や動物についての説明文（約250語）を読み、内容に合う答えを5問選ぶ
parts.tip: 質問は段落の順に出ることが多い。1問ずつ、その段落にもどって答えを探す。最後の「What is this story about?」は、話全体で一番伝えたいことを選ぶ。
parts.intro: Read the passage and choose the best answer to each question.

sets.passage:
The Book Bus

Rosa Martin grew up in Pinewood, a small town in the mountains. When she was a child, there was no library in her town. The nearest one was in a city two hours away by car. Rosa loved reading, but her family could not buy many books. Her favorite day of the year was her birthday, because her aunt always sent her a new book.

After Rosa finished university, she became an English teacher at Pinewood Junior High School. She soon noticed that many of her students did not read much. "There are not enough books in this town," she thought. Then she had an idea. Her uncle had an old school bus that he did not use anymore. Rosa asked him if she could have it, and he said yes.

Rosa and her students worked on the bus every weekend for six months. They took out most of the seats and put in shelves. People in the town gave them more than 1,000 books. Rosa called it the Book Bus.

Now, the Book Bus visits a different part of Pinewood every Saturday. Anyone can borrow up to three books for two weeks, and it is free. Children often come to the bus with their parents, and Rosa reads stories to them. Some people in other towns have heard about the Book Bus, and they are planning to start their own. Rosa says, "Books can open doors to new worlds. I want every child to have that chance."

questions.q: When Rosa was a child,
choices: she lived in a big city.
there was no library in her town.
questions.why: 第1段落：子どもの頃、町に図書館が無かった。一番近い図書館は車で2時間の都市にあった。

questions.q: What did Rosa notice after she became a teacher?
choices: Her students wanted to learn to drive.
The school bus was too old.
The library in the city was closed.
Many of her students did not read much.
questions.why: 第2段落：先生になってすぐ、生徒の多くがあまり本を読まないことに気づいた。

questions.q: Where did Rosa get the bus?
questions.why: 第2段落の最後：おじさんが使っていない古いスクールバスを持っていて、もらってもいいかと聞いたら Yes と言った。

questions.q: What did Rosa and her students do for six months?
choices: They changed the inside of the bus.
questions.why: 第3段落：毎週末に作業し、座席を外して本だなを付けた。1,000冊は町の人からもらった本の数。

questions.q: What is this story about?
choices: A girl who wanted to be a bus driver.
A teacher who made a library on a bus.
A town that built a new school.
A student who wrote many books.
questions.why: 全体：本が足りない町で、先生の Rosa が古いバスを図書館に変えた話。

sets.passage:
Sea Otters

Sea otters are small animals that live in the ocean. They are found along the coasts of the northern Pacific Ocean, from North America to Russia and the north of Japan. An adult sea otter is about 1.2 meters long.

Many animals that live in cold water, such as whales and seals, have a thick layer of fat to keep them warm. But sea otters do not have much fat. Instead, they have very thick fur. In fact, sea otters have thicker fur than any other animal in the world. They spend a lot of time cleaning their fur, because dirty fur cannot keep them warm.

Sea otters eat sea urchins, crabs, and clams. These animals have hard shells, so sea otters use tools to open them. A sea otter floats on its back, puts a stone on its stomach, and hits the shell against the stone. Some sea otters keep their favorite stone under their arm and use it again and again.

Sea otters also sleep while they float on the water. When they sleep, they sometimes hold hands with each other, so they do not float away from their group. Some also wrap long seaweed around their bodies.

A long time ago, many people hunted sea otters for their beautiful fur. By the early 1900s, there were very few sea otters left. Later, many countries made laws to protect them. Since then, the number of sea otters has slowly increased.

questions.q: Where do sea otters live?
choices: In warm seas near the south of Japan.
In the ocean in the north of the Pacific.
Only on the coast of Russia.
questions.why: 第1段落：北太平洋の沿岸、北アメリカからロシア、日本の北まで。ロシアだけではない。

questions.q: How do sea otters keep warm?
choices: They have a lot of fat.
questions.why: 第2段落：クジラやアザラシとちがい脂肪は少なく、代わりにとても厚い毛で体を温かく保つ。

questions.q: Why do sea otters use stones?
choices: To open the hard shells of their food.
questions.why: 第3段落：ウニやカニ、貝はかたい殻があるので、おなかの上の石に打ちつけて開ける。

questions.q: Sea otters sometimes hold hands
choices: when they are hunted by people.
so that they do not float away while they sleep.
questions.why: 第4段落：寝ている時、群れから流されないように手をつなぐことがある。

questions.q: What happened after many countries made laws to protect sea otters?
choices: People started to hunt them for their fur.
Sea otters moved to the south.
The number of sea otters became larger.
questions.why: 最後の段落：法律で守られてから、ラッコの数は少しずつ増えた（has slowly increased）。

sets.passage:
Tom's Bike Shop

Tom Baker is fourteen years old, and he lives in a town called Riverside. When he was ten, his old bike broke. His father did not have time to fix it, so Tom watched videos on the Internet and fixed it by himself. He found that he really enjoyed fixing things.

One day, Tom saw a lot of old bikes at the town's garbage center. Some of them only had small problems, like flat tires or broken chains. Tom thought, "It's a waste to throw these away." He asked the workers at the center if he could take some home. They were surprised, but they said yes.

Every weekend, Tom worked on the bikes in his family's garage. His father helped him buy new parts, and his neighbors gave him old tools. After a few months, Tom had fixed twelve bikes. He gave them to children in his town whose families could not buy new ones.

Soon, a newspaper in Riverside wrote a story about Tom. After that, many people brought their old bikes to his house. A local bike shop also offered to give him parts for free. Now, Tom has fixed more than 100 bikes. Some high school students help him on Sundays, and he teaches them how to fix brakes and chains.

Tom wants to open his own bike shop when he grows up. He says, "I want to show people that old things can still be useful."

questions.q: How did Tom learn to fix his bike?
choices: By taking lessons at a bike shop.
By reading a book from the library.

sets.passage:
Busy Honeybees

Honeybees are small insects, but they are very important to people. They make honey, and they also help many fruits and vegetables to grow.

Honeybees live together in a large group called a colony. A colony can have more than 30,000 bees. In each colony, there is only one queen bee. She is bigger than the other bees, and her job is to lay eggs. She can lay more than 1,000 eggs in one day. Most of the other bees are worker bees. They clean the nest, take care of the young bees, and fly out to collect food from flowers.

When a worker bee finds a good place with many flowers, it goes back to the nest and does a special dance. The dance shows the other bees which way to fly and how far the flowers are. In this way, the bees can find food quickly.

Making honey is hard work. Bees drink a sweet liquid from flowers and carry it back to the nest. There, they slowly change it into honey. One worker bee makes less than one teaspoon of honey in its whole life.

While bees move from flower to flower, they carry pollen on their bodies. This helps plants make fruit and seeds. Apples, strawberries, and many other foods need bees to grow. However, the number of honeybees has been going down in some places. Many scientists are now studying how to protect them.

questions.q: Why does a worker bee do a special dance?

To make the queen bee happy.
To change the sweet liquid into honey.
questions.why: 第3段落：ダンスで、ほかのハチにどちらへどれくらい飛べば花があるかを伝える。

questions.q: What is true about making honey?

It takes only one day to make honey.
Only the queen bee can make honey.
questions.why: 第4段落：働きバチ1匹が一生で作るはちみつは小さじ1杯より少ない。はちみつは巣に持ち帰ってから作る。

people want to eat less honey.
questions.why: 最後の段落：一部の地域でミツバチの数が減っているので、守る方法を研究している。has been going down を fewer と言いかえている。

parts.title: リスニング第1部 会話の応答文選択

parts.tip: 最後の1文が一番大事。When・Where・How many・How long など、最初の疑問詞を聞き取る。会話に出た語をくり返すだけの選択肢はひっかけのことが多い。
parts.intro: Listen to the conversation and choose the best response from the three choices.

sets.script:
M: Hi, Jenny. Is that a new bag?
W: Yes. My mom gave it to me for my birthday.
M: It's really nice. When was your birthday?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: When（いつ）と誕生日を聞かれているので「この前の日曜日」。場所や年齢は When の答えではない。

sets.script:

sets.script:

sets.script:

M: Yes. It's my favorite.

parts.title: リスニング第2部 会話の内容一致選択
parts.desc: 2人の会話と質問を聞き、答えを4つから選ぶ。放送は2回
parts.tip: 放送の前に4つの選択肢を見て、何が聞かれそうか（時間・場所・人・理由）を予想する。1回目で大体をつかみ、2回目で質問の答えの部分をしっかり聞く。
parts.intro: Listen to the conversation and the question. Choose the best answer from the four choices.

sets.script:
W: Hi, Sam. Are you going to the school festival on Saturday?
M: Yes. My class is going to sell hot dogs.
W: That sounds fun. My class is doing a play.
M: Great. I'll come and watch it after lunch.
Question: What will Sam's class do at the school festival?

questions.q: What will Sam's class do at the school festival?
questions.why: 男の子（Sam）は「ぼくのクラスはホットドッグを売る」と言っている。劇をするのは女の子のクラス。

sets.script:
M: Mom, can I go to Jack's house after school today?
W: Did you finish your homework?
M: Not yet. I'll do it after dinner.
W: No. Please do it first. Then you can go.
Question: What does the boy's mother want him to do?

questions.q: What does the boy's mother want him to do?
questions.why: 母は Please do it first.（先に宿題をやって）と言っている。終わったら行ってもいい。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. How much are these apples?
M: They're one dollar each, or five for four dollars.
W: Then I'll take five, please.
M: Sure. Here you are.
Question: How much will the woman pay?

questions.q: How much will the woman pay?
questions.why: 1個1ドル、5個なら4ドル。女性は5個買うので4ドル。5ドルと答えないように注意。

sets.script:
M: Lucy, you're good at drawing. Where did you learn?
W: My aunt is an artist. She teaches me every Sunday.
M: Really? Does she live near you?
W: Yes. Her house is next to mine.
Question: Who teaches Lucy how to draw?

questions.q: Who teaches Lucy how to draw?
questions.why: 女の子は「おばが画家で、毎週日曜に教えてくれる」と言っている。

sets.script:
W: Dad, it's raining. Can you take me to the library?
M: Sorry, I'm using the car this afternoon.
W: Then I'll take the bus.
M: OK. Don't forget your umbrella.
Question: How will the girl go to the library?

questions.q: How will the girl go to the library?
questions.why: 父は午後に車を使うので乗せられない。女の子は Then I'll take the bus.（じゃあバスで行く）と言っている。

sets.script:
M: Are you ready for the trip to the mountains tomorrow?
W: Almost. I bought a new jacket yesterday.
M: Good. It may be cold at night.
W: I know. I'll also bring a sweater.
Question: What did the woman do yesterday?

questions.q: What did the woman do yesterday?
questions.why: 女性は「昨日新しいジャケットを買った」と言っている。山へ行くのは明日。セーターは持っていく物。

sets.script:
W: Hi, Ben. You weren't at practice yesterday.
M: I had a headache, so I went home early.
W: Are you OK now?
M: Yes, I feel much better. I'll come today.
Question: Why didn't Ben go to practice yesterday?

questions.q: Why didn't Ben go to practice yesterday?
questions.why: Ben は「頭が痛かったので早く帰った」と言っている。病院に行ったとは言っていない。

sets.script:
M: Excuse me. When does the museum close today?
W: It usually closes at five, but today it's open until eight.
M: Why is that?
W: There's a special event tonight.
Question: What time will the museum close today?

questions.q: What time will the museum close today?
questions.why: ふだんは5時に閉まるが、今日は特別なイベントがあるので8時まで開いている。

sets.script:
W: What are you going to do this weekend, Tom?
M: I'm going to go fishing with my grandfather.
W: That's nice. Where will you go?
M: To a lake near his house.
Question: Who will Tom go fishing with?

questions.q: Who will Tom go fishing with?
questions.why: Tom は「祖父と釣りに行く」と言っている。場所は祖父の家の近くの湖。

sets.script:
M: Mom, I can't find my math notebook.
W: Did you leave it at school?
M: No. I used it last night at the kitchen table.
W: Then look under the newspapers there.
Question: Where did the boy use his notebook last night?

questions.q: Where did the boy use his notebook last night?
questions.why: 男の子は「昨夜台所のテーブルで使った」と言っている。母は学校に忘れたか聞いたが、ちがった。

sets.script:
W: Hello, this is Mary. Can I speak to Mr. Hall?
M: Sorry, he's in a meeting now.
W: OK. Could you ask him to call me back?
M: Sure. I'll tell him.
Question: What does Mary ask the man to do?

questions.q: What does Mary ask the man to do?
choices: Tell Mr. Hall to call her.
questions.why: Mary は Could you ask him to call me back?（彼に折り返し電話するように伝えて）と頼んでいる。

sets.script:
M: Kate, how was your piano contest?
W: I didn't win, but I played well.
M: That's good. What will you do next?
W: I'll practice harder for the contest next year.
Question: What is the girl going to do?

questions.q: What is the girl going to do?
questions.why: 女の子は「来年のコンテストに向けてもっと練習する」と言っている。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. Is there a bookstore near here?
M: Yes. There's one on the second floor of this building.
W: Thanks. Is there an elevator?
M: Yes, it's over there by the café.
Question: Where is the bookstore?

questions.q: Where is the bookstore?
questions.why: 男性は「この建物の2階にある」と答えている。カフェのそばにあるのはエレベーター。

sets.script:
M: Grace, do you want to have lunch together?
W: I'd love to, but I have to see Mr. Wood.
M: About the English speech contest?
W: Yes. He's going to check my speech.
Question: Why does Grace have to see Mr. Wood?

questions.q: Why does Grace have to see Mr. Wood?
choices: She wants to have lunch with him.
He will give her a prize.
questions.why: Grace は「先生がスピーチを見てくれる」と言っている。だから昼ごはんを一緒に食べられない。

sets.script:
W: Your new watch is nice, Jim.
M: Thanks. My parents gave it to me.
W: Was it for your birthday?
M: No. It was a present for passing my test.
Question: Why did Jim get a new watch?

questions.q: Why did Jim get a new watch?
questions.why: 誕生日ではなく、テストに合格したお祝いのプレゼント。

sets.script:
M: Mom, there's no milk in the fridge.
W: Oh, I forgot to buy some.
M: I'll go to the store and get some.
W: Thanks. Can you get some bread, too?
Question: What will the boy buy?

questions.q: What will the boy buy?
questions.why: 男の子が牛乳を買いに行くと言い、母がパンもお願いした。だから牛乳とパン。

sets.script:
W: Do you often go to the swimming pool, Mark?
M: Yes, I go every Tuesday and Thursday.
W: Do you go on weekends, too?
M: No. It's too crowded then.
Question: When does Mark go to the swimming pool?

questions.q: When does Mark go to the swimming pool?
questions.why: Mark は毎週火曜と木曜に行く。週末は混んでいるので行かない。

sets.script:
M: Hi, Ellen. How was your trip to Canada?
W: It was great. I visited my cousin there.
M: Did you see any snow?
W: No. It was summer, so it was warm.
Question: What did Ellen do in Canada?

questions.q: What did Ellen do in Canada?
choices: She saw a lot of snow.
questions.why: Ellen は「いとこを訪ねた」と言っている。夏だったので雪は見ていない。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. Which train goes to Lake Town?
M: The red one on Platform 3.
W: How long does it take?
M: About forty minutes.
Question: How long does it take to get to Lake Town?

questions.q: How long does it take to get to Lake Town?
questions.why: 最後に About forty minutes.（約40分）と答えている。3はホームの番号。forty と fourteen の聞き分けに注意。

sets.script:
M: Linda, what are you making?
W: Cookies for my friend Nancy. It's her birthday tomorrow.
M: They smell good. Can I have one?
W: Sorry. You can have some after I wrap Nancy's.
Question: Why is Linda making cookies?

questions.q: Why is Linda making cookies?
questions.why: Linda は友だちの Nancy の明日の誕生日のためにクッキーを作っている。

parts.title: リスニング第3部 文の内容一致選択
parts.desc: 1人が話す短い話やお知らせと質問を聞き、答えを4つから選ぶ。放送は2回
parts.tip: だれの話か、いつの話かを最初につかむ。But・So・Instead の後で話が変わることが多いので、そこを聞きのがさない。お知らせは最後の「お願い」がよく聞かれる。
parts.intro: Listen to the passage and the question. Choose the best answer from the four choices.

sets.script:
Last Saturday, Mika went shopping with her mother. She wanted to buy a new pair of shoes, but the shoes she liked were too expensive. Instead, she bought a red hat. She is going to wear it to the park tomorrow.
Question: What did Mika buy last Saturday?

questions.q: What did Mika buy last Saturday?
questions.why: 気に入ったくつは高すぎたので、代わりに赤い帽子を買った。

sets.script:
Good morning, students. Today, we were going to have P.E. class outside, but it is raining. So we will play basketball in the gym instead. Please change your clothes and come to the gym by 10:30.
Question: Where will the students have P.E. class today?

questions.q: Where will the students have P.E. class today?
questions.why: 雨なので外ではなく、体育館でバスケットボールをする。

sets.script:
My brother Jack loves animals. He has two cats and a rabbit. Every Sunday, he works as a volunteer at an animal hospital near our house. He wants to become an animal doctor in the future.
Question: What does Jack do every Sunday?

questions.q: What does Jack do every Sunday?
choices: He buys food for his cats.
He works at an animal hospital.
questions.why: 毎週日曜に、家の近くの動物病院でボランティアをしている。

sets.script:
Kenta started playing tennis when he was ten. At first, he practiced with his father. Now he is in the tennis club at his junior high school. Next month, he will play in a big tournament in Osaka.
Question: What will Kenta do next month?

questions.q: What will Kenta do next month?
questions.why: 来月、大阪の大きな大会に出る。テニス部にはもう入っている。

sets.script:
Attention, shoppers. Today only, all fruit in our store is 20 percent off. Also, if you buy more than 30 dollars of food, you will get a free shopping bag. Thank you for shopping at Fresh Mart.
Question: What can shoppers get if they spend more than 30 dollars?

questions.q: What can shoppers get if they spend more than 30 dollars?
questions.why: 30ドルより多く買うと、無料の買い物袋がもらえる。20パーセント引きは果物の話。

sets.script:
Yesterday, Emily wanted to bake a cake for her father's birthday. But when she opened the fridge, there were no eggs. She called her friend Sarah, and Sarah brought some eggs to her house. The cake was delicious.
Question: What was Emily's problem?

questions.q: What was Emily's problem?
choices: Sarah couldn't come to her house.
questions.why: 冷蔵庫を開けたら卵が無かった。友だちの Sarah が持ってきてくれた。

sets.script:
I usually go to school by bike. But this morning, my bike had a flat tire. My mother was busy, so she couldn't drive me. I had to walk to school, and I was ten minutes late.
Question: How did the girl go to school this morning?

questions.q: How did the girl go to school this morning?
questions.why: 自転車がパンクして、母も忙しかったので、歩いて学校に行った。

sets.script:
Tom's family went to the beach last summer. On the first day, they swam in the sea. On the second day, it was rainy, so they visited an aquarium. Tom liked the penguins the best.
Question: What did Tom's family do on the second day?

questions.q: What did Tom's family do on the second day?
questions.why: 2日目は雨だったので水族館に行った。海で泳いだのは1日目。

sets.script:
Welcome to Green Hill Library. The library is open from nine a.m. to seven p.m. on weekdays. On weekends, it closes at five p.m. You can borrow up to five books for two weeks.
Question: What time does the library close on Saturdays?

questions.q: What time does the library close on Saturdays?
questions.why: 平日は夜7時までだが、週末（土日）は夕方5時に閉まる。

sets.script:
Last week, Nancy's grandmother came to visit from Canada. Nancy took her to a temple and a famous garden. Her grandmother liked Japanese food very much, especially tempura. She will come back again next spring.
Question: Which Japanese food did Nancy's grandmother like the most?

questions.q: Which Japanese food did Nancy's grandmother like the most?
questions.why: 日本食がとても気に入り、especially tempura（特に天ぷら）と言っている。ほかの料理は出てこない。

sets.script:
Hiroshi wanted to buy a new video game, but he didn't have enough money. So he started helping his neighbors. He washed their cars and walked their dogs. After two months, he bought the game.
Question: How did Hiroshi get money for the game?

questions.q: How did Hiroshi get money for the game?
choices: His parents gave it to him.
questions.why: 近所の人の車を洗ったり犬の散歩をしたりして、お金をためた。

sets.script:
Thank you for flying with Sky Line. We will arrive in Sydney in about thirty minutes. The weather in Sydney is sunny, and the temperature is 25 degrees. Please put your seat belts on now.
Question: What are the passengers asked to do?

questions.q: What are the passengers asked to do?
questions.why: 最後の文：Please put your seat belts on now.（今シートベルトをしめてください）。

sets.script:
My sister and I have different hobbies. I like playing soccer, and she likes reading books. But we both like cooking. Every Sunday, we make lunch together for our family.
Question: What do the speaker and his sister do on Sundays?

questions.q: What do the speaker and his sister do on Sundays?
questions.why: 2人とも料理が好きで、毎週日曜に家族の昼ごはんを一緒に作る。サッカーと読書はそれぞれの趣味。

sets.script:
Ms. Brown is a math teacher. She is very kind, and her classes are easy to understand. After school, she often helps students who have questions. Many students say math is their favorite subject now.
Question: What does Ms. Brown often do after school?

questions.q: What does Ms. Brown often do after school?
questions.why: 放課後、質問のある生徒をよく手伝っている。

sets.script:
This summer, Daniel is going to visit his uncle in Hawaii. He is going to stay there for two weeks. He wants to learn how to surf. His uncle is a good surfer, so he will teach Daniel.
Question: How long will Daniel stay in Hawaii?

questions.q: How long will Daniel stay in Hawaii?
questions.why: 2週間滞在する（stay there for two weeks）。

sets.script:
Last night, Amy watched a movie on TV. It was about a dog that found its way home. The story was very exciting, and at the end, Amy cried. She wants to read the book of the movie, too.
Question: What does Amy want to do?

questions.q: What does Amy want to do?
choices: Read the book of the movie.
questions.why: 最後の文：その映画の本も読みたい。

sets.script:
Hello, everyone. Our school's chorus contest will be held on November 10. Each class will sing two songs. Please practice every day after school. The winning class will sing at the city music festival in December.
Question: What will the winning class do?

questions.q: What will the winning class do?
choices: Sing at a festival in December.
questions.why: 優勝したクラスは12月の市の音楽祭で歌う。毎日の練習はすべてのクラスへのお願い。

sets.script:
Mr. Ito likes to cook. He usually cooks Japanese food, but last weekend, he tried to make Indian curry for the first time. It was a little too hot, but his children said it was delicious.
Question: What did Mr. Ito do last weekend?

questions.q: What did Mr. Ito do last weekend?
choices: He went to an Indian restaurant.
questions.why: 先週末、初めてインドカレーを作った。ふだんは和食を作る。

sets.script:
Jessica has been learning Japanese for three years. She practices by watching Japanese anime. Next year, she will go to Japan as an exchange student. She is excited to make Japanese friends.
Question: Why will Jessica go to Japan next year?

questions.q: Why will Jessica go to Japan next year?
choices: To work at an anime company.
To study as an exchange student.
questions.why: 来年、交換留学生として日本に行く。アニメは練習の方法。

sets.script:
Our class went on a trip to a farm yesterday. We picked strawberries and fed the cows. My favorite part was riding a horse. It was my first time, and it was a lot of fun.
Question: What did the boy like the best about the trip?

questions.q: What did the boy like the best about the trip?
questions.why: My favorite part was riding a horse.（一番よかったのは馬に乗ったこと）。

parts.title: 二次試験 面接
parts.desc: 約30語の文を音読し、文の内容の質問1つと自分についての質問2つに答える（イラストの質問は省略）
parts.tip: No.1 は so の前の部分が答えになることが多い。主語を They にかえて Because ～. で答える。自分についての質問は、短くてもいいので主語と動詞のある文で言い切る。だまってしまうより Let me see. で考える。
parts.intro: Read the card silently for 20 seconds, read it aloud, then answer the questions.

tasks.prompt: Please read the passage aloud.
tasks.readAloud:
Summer Festivals

Summer festivals are popular in Japan. People enjoy watching fireworks and eating food at the stalls. Many people wear yukata, so they can feel the summer season.
tasks.ja: まず20秒だまって読み、タイトルから音読する。コンマ（,）や so の前で少し区切る。

tasks.prompt: Please look at the passage. Why can many people feel the summer season?
tasks.ja: 答えの形：Because they wear yukata.（so の前の部分を見て、主語を they などに変える）

tasks.prompt: What do you usually do on weekends?
tasks.ja: 自分のことを1〜2文で。主語と動詞のある文で答える。

tasks.prompt: Do you like summer?
tasks.ja: まず Yes. / No. で答える。続きの質問：Yes → Please tell me more. / No → Why not?

tasks.ja: 答えの形：Because they want to cook healthy food.（so の前の部分を見て、主語を they などに変える）

tasks.ja: 答えの形：Because many libraries are quiet.（so の前の部分を見て、主語を they などに変える）

tasks.readAloud:

Taking pictures is a popular hobby. People often take pictures of their friends and beautiful places. Many smartphones have good cameras, so people can take pictures easily.
